description: This source file defines utility functions and enums for processing command-line arguments and environment variable invocations in the context of executing environment wrappers. It includes functions to unwrap nested env commands, parse command tokens, and handle modifiers and environment assignments.

methods.name: basenameLower
methods.description: Returns the lowercase basename of a token after trimming whitespace and normalizing slashes.

methods.name: isEnvAssignment
methods.description: Checks if a token matches the pattern of an environment variable assignment (e.g., VAR=value).

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps a command array by removing env wrappers, if possible.

methods.name: unwrapWithMetadata
methods.description: Analyzes command tokens to determine and extract the core command, also indicating the use of modifiers.

methods.name: unwrapDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Recursively unwraps nested env commands up to a specified max depth, ignoring those with modifiers.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentEnvInvocation
methods.description: Checks if a command is a transparent env invocation and extracts the underlying command tokens.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Recursively unwraps transparent env wrappers, ignoring those with modifiers.
